state.misconception_label: Struggles to visualise nets of 3D shapes

turn_history.speaker: student
turn_history.text: I have: This is the net of a... ![A circle touching a sector](). I got Triangle because I'm not sure I worked it out the right way.

turn_history.speaker: teacher
turn_history.text: Can you explain why you chose Triangle as the net for this shape? What characteristics of the shape led you to that choice?

turn_history.speaker: student
turn_history.text: I thought it was a Triangle because it kind of looks like one when I fold it in my head. But now that you mention it, I’m not sure how the circle and the sector fit together. Can you help me see what the net really shows?

turn_history.speaker: teacher
turn_history.text: Can you think of any other 3D shapes that have circular faces? How do you think the circle and sector could be connected to form a 3D shape?

score.justification_pass1: The teacher effectively engages the misconception through probing questions that maintain high cognitive demand and appropriate scaffolding, though the student shows only partial progress toward recognizing the cone by the dialogue's end.
score.justification_pass2: The teacher consistently uses probing questions to guide the student's thinking without ever directly providing the answer, which is a textbook example of the Socratic method.
